data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, the email recipient, and the subject and body templates right, but it omits the blog parameter and the new-tab visit to the blog. It also ends with "Send/close" where the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, and it treats the latest post as coming from the GitHub profile. It lists the outputs (followers, top_repo and so on) as parameters even though they are scraped, and it never says how to obtain them. An automation built from this spec would visit the wrong place for the latest post and could send the email by mistake.
